text.description_html:
LCN 4410ME Fire Safety Door Closer

The LCN 4410ME SENTRONIC is a heavy duty, electrically controlled closer/holder designed to provide infinitely adjustable hold-open for fire and smoke barrier doors. Door is held open until current interruption releases mechanism and the door closes. Double lever arm closer is specifically designed for interior doors.

The LCN 4410ME series closer shipped with a 24V or 120V cylinder (please specify) on a mounting plate, metal cover, regular arm, and wood and machine screw pack. It is UL listed for smoke barrier or labeled fire doors. cUL listed for self-closing doors without hold open. Tested and certified under ANSI Standard A156.15. Conforms to life safety code, NFPA 101. Sized #4 cylinder for Interior Doors up to 4'0".

Functions as a full rack and pinion closer when hold-open is not engaged or current is interrupted. Built-in “On/Off” switch controls hold-open function and the Swing-Free arm allows door to be moved without door closer resistance.

Features and Specifications for LCN 4414ME Fire Safety Door Closer

  • Door Width: Interior Door 34" - 48"
  • Maximum Opening: 160º
  • Mounting: Top Jamb
  • Handed
  • Interfaces with Alarm Systems
  • Certified ANSI Standard A156.15
  • Conforms to NFPA 101
  • UL Listed
  • cUL Listed for Self-Closing Doors
  • LCN 4410ME Information (PDF)

The LCN 4414ME is available with optional 120V or 24V cylinder in Aluminum Finish.

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this door closer:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
